selection.scope: each image and each scale independently
selection.ordering: first-stage error descending; ties use ascending raster index

mask_coding.probability_model: adaptive Laplace counts initialized as zero=1, one=1; counts update after every decoded symbol
mask_coding.independent_segments: one segment per image and scale
mask_coding.excluded_bits: first-depth indices, active second-depth indices, LDPC, BPSK, probability headers
mask_coding.framing_metadata: token count and arithmetic segment payload length are assumed known out of band
